drums.tags: Hard rock drum solo. The performance features a standard acoustic drum kit with a crisp, dry snare, a resonant kick drum, and bright crash cymbals. The drummer executes rapid-fire sixteenth-note snare rolls and syncopated kick drum patterns. The rhythm utilizes frequent accents on the snare and sudden cymbal crashes to punctuate the phrasing. The recording has a close-mic'ed, studio-dry aesthetic with minimal room reverb. 130 BPM, 4/4 time signature.

bass.tags: Funk instrumental featuring a prominent slap bass guitar performance. The bass utilizes percussive thumb slaps and finger pops, executing a syncopated 16th-note riff with frequent dead notes and chromatic slides. A dry, close-miked drum kit maintains a steady groove with a crisp snare and tight hi-hats. The recording has a raw, unprocessed studio aesthetic with minimal reverb. Key of E minor. 105 BPM.
